notes:
{昇進|しょうしん} means being promoted to a higher position or rank at work. As a suru-verb, it means "to be promoted", "to advance in rank".

Related terms:
- ⟦{昇給|しょうきゅう}→昇給：04687_shoukyuu⟧ (salary increase)
- ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧ (demotion) - antonym
- ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧ (career advancement, getting ahead)

Common expressions:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{昇進|しょうしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (be promoted to ~)
- {昇進|しょうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧ (aim for promotion)
- {昇進|しょうしん}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (promotion exam)
